summary: Chino Valley Unified School Board President Sonja Shaw refused to let a pro-Palestinian group (PPP) speak at a board meeting while other boards passed ceasefire resolutions.
quote: Chino Valley Unified School Board President Sonja Shaw refuses to allow PPP to hijack a meeting. This as other school boards are passing ceasefire resolutions.

summary: Sonja Shaw appeared on Fox News @ Night (Dec 19, 2023) discussing 'the concern over the growing antisemitism in young people' in the context of the Israel-Gaza conflict.
quote: Julie Hamill, Sonja Shaw and Christina Pascucci, discuss the concern over the growing antisemitism in young people on 'Fox News @ Night.'
